posts.author: Retrowild
posts.body:
First time poster to this forum.
Recently started designing my first real project using RPG Maker 2003 and i've been making decent progress with videos and other assistance. Most things I can just figure out myself but recently i've wanted to make a type of potion that might heal you, and might hurt you. I could probably make an item that works with a series of switches to make this work, maybe.. But it sounds like a lot of effort for an ultimately minor item. Is there an easier way to make a medicine that harms you / MAY harm you?

posts.author: Litningman06
posts.body:
A way to do this would be to have an Autorun common event that is called by a switch that is set by using the item.
The potion would be a "Switch" type item instead of a "Medicine" one, and you would have the common event heal or harm the player based on whatever condition you wanted, whether it be random using variables, or some other condition.

posts.author: AkiraKotatsuhime
posts.body:
Such event would only work outside of the default battle-screen and would have no clue about which character it has to heal/damage if you're handling multiple actors.
In other words: If you rely on the RPG Maker's default systems, absolutely no chance. Effects and targeting of skills and items were very very restrictive in all ver prior to RPGVXAce. Things like this could be manually programmed into the open game-engine-part of RPGXP or any newer.
